title: Review of c18's flshell2 (IBMED): I, M and D replicate on fresh seeds 7-8 and a daughter food cut kills the starved daughter on seed 8 (E, by construction); the S shell replicates as a halo at a fixed kernel radius with a gap to the body, and its feedback raises top speed 19-29% but not distance or division, so B is not supported
summary: Re-ran world.py and its h5=0 twin on seeds 7 and 8 (t=800) and the claim's dfork.py (fork from t=150, 300 t after) on both. Gliders divide (3 and 10 persistent splits, generation 2 and 7; twin 9 and 7, generation 5 and 4) and glide up to 15.5 and 10.7 body lengths. shellprof.py: S peaks at 9-10 px (0.38-0.39) with 0.02-0.06 inside and 0.02 outside, closed in 55-60% of isolated body-frames; tracks.png shows a ring separated from the body by a dark gap (body matter at the ring 0.02-0.05). Feedback on vs off: top-track median speed 0.575 vs 0.484 and 0.517 vs 0.400, but median body lengths 7.8 vs 8.4 and 6.2 vs 6.6, moving tracks 27 vs 46 and 41 vs 26, and fewer splits on seed 7. Fork: on seed 8 the food-cut daughter falls from 61 to ~5 within ~190 t while its sister persists and the same daughter in the fed twin grows to 87; on seed 7 the two daughters re-merged right after the fork, so the test is not clean there (the merged body shrinks from 133 to 28 when cut, and holds 140 when fed).

observations.I: rerun/seed8/tracks.png: compact gliders persisting 120-160 frames between collisions; 10-14 bodies
observations.M: speedcmp.json: max 15.5 and 10.7 body lengths, top-track median 7.8 and 6.2 body lengths; no imposed field
observations.E: forks/df8.png: food cut that follows one daughter: mass 61 -> ~5 by t~345 (190 t after the fork) while the sister persists; fed twin daughter 61 -> 87
observations.D: rerun/seed7, seed8 lineage.png: 3 and 10 persistent splits, generation 2 and 7

seeds_run.result: pass for I, M, D (3 persistent splits, gen 2, 15.5 body lengths); fork not clean: daughters re-merged
pass for I, M, D, E (10 persistent splits, gen 7; starved daughter dies, sister and fed twin persist)

controls_run.E: forks/df8.png (fed twin vs following food cut, seed 8; seed 7 in forks/df7.png)

verdicts.limitation: E holds by construction (matter is made only from food and decays back into it). B: S is grown wherever a ring-kernel convolution of the body density hits a set point, so it is a halo at the kernel radius, a contour of the body field by construction, separated from the body by a gap; RUBRIC L3 caps such a channel at Weak unless an ablation shows it does work, and the feedback ablation gives a modest rise in top speed (19-29% here) without more distance travelled, more moving tracks or more division. Individuals grow from one noise patch (no S claimed). The seed-7 fork is ambiguous. Two seeds.
